title: Is cranwhales outdated ?
description:
Tried to run pieces of code but am getting errors. Note: I have loaded `shinydashboardPlus` after `shinydashboard`. 

Used

`valueBoxOutput` & `renderValueBox`

Error message says: 
`Error in tagAssert: Expected an object with class 'shiny.tag'.`

@jcheng5 could you please confirm that `cranwhales` is updated after launch of `shinydashboardPlus` ? If yes then I will open an issue after a thorough testing and reprex. If no (which is likely) do you suggest we do not persue cranwhales and go directly to some other repo that was built straight on from the new package?

Will appreciate your views.

Sanjay
